question: There are 80 students in a hostel. Due to new admissions, 30 new students join the mess, and the daily expense of the mess increases by ₹260, while the average expenditure per head diminishes by ₹10. What was the original daily expenditure (in ₹, rounded off to the nearest tens) of the mess?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net decrease in total average expense for 110 students = 110 × 10 = ₹1100

Expected sum of 30 new students at original average (x) = Actual increase + Net decrease

30 × x = 260 + 1100 = 1360 ⇒ x = 136/3

Original total expenditure = 80 × (136/3) = 10880/3 = ₹3626.67

Rounding off to the nearest tens gives ₹3630.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3630.**
